summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/operations POST route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before course ownership checks or operation writes run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: Failed with HTTP 400 because a validly signed but unsafe actorId reached later route/store validation instead of being rejected at the authenticated-session boundary.

npx vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed teacher session ids"
redGreenEvidence.observed: Failed with HTTP 400 because a validly signed but unsafe sessionId reached later route/store validation instead of being rejected at the authenticated-session boundary.

redGreenEvidence.command: npx vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed teacher actor ids|unsafe signed teacher session ids|persists authorized teacher operations"

behaviorHardened: Signed teacher cookies whose actorId is not a safe teaching operation id now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed teacher cookies whose sessionId is not a safe teaching operation id now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before course ownership checks, external storage adapters, local operation writes, audit event writes, or domain projection writes run.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.

boundary: This is local backend/API auth-boundary hardening for the ordinary teaching operation POST route. It does not replace fresh same-run live production ordinary teaching route/browser smoke artifacts or the aggregate enterprise gate.
